issues.title: Carried villagers' head and body jitter on Fabric 26.2
issues.body:
### Environment
- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric
- Carry On 2.11.0 (`carryon-fabric-26.2-2.11.0.jar`)

### Steps to reproduce
1. Pick up a villager with Carry On.
2. Keep carrying it and watch its head and body, especially while moving or turning.
3. The head/body often keep shaking or changing orientation between frames. Villagers with professions are affected too.

### Expected behavior
The carried villager keeps a stable rendered orientation.

### Suspected cause
`CarriedObjectRender` resets `xRotO` and `yRotO` before `extractEntity(entity, partialTicks)`, and `CarryRenderHelper.applyEntityTransformations` resets them again. The current `xRot` and `yRot` can still contain the entity's original NBT rotation. Each frame then interpolates from zero toward that old angle. The living-entity head/body rotations also use interpolated state.

Resetting current X/Y rotations together with their previous values in both paths resolves the mismatch and covers other carried `LivingEntity` types.

issues.title: [Bug] Compatibility inquiry regarding EMF Compat / EMF on 26.2
issues.body:
**Describe the bug**
This is a compatibility inquiry and notification rather than a standard game crash. In the `emf-compat` repository, the maintainer (@victorkozhokin) noted that `EMF Compat: Carry On` v2.0.0 could not be released for 26.2 due to a suspected architectural issue or rendering conflict involving Carry On and EMF (Entity Model Features). I am opening this to bring it to your attention so both teams can coordinate.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Check compatibility between Carry On and EMF / EMF Compat on version 26.2.
2. Note that `EMF Compat: Carry On` v2.0.0 is currently withheld/unsupported for 26.2 due to an architectural conflict.

**Screenshots**
Full discussion and context on GitHub:
https://github.com/victorkozhokin/emf-compat/issues/25

**Game Information (please complete the following information):**
- Minecraft Version: 26.2
- Mod Loader and Version: Fabric [Loader sürümün, örn: 0.16.x]
- Carry On Version: [Carry On sürümünü buraya yaz]

**Additional context, logs**
The maintainer of `emf-compat` mentioned the following in issue #25:
> *"There's an architectural bug in Carry On as of 26.2. Traben is aware of it."*

And later clarified:
> *"Regarding Carry on, write to the author and send a link to the issue. To be honest, most likely the mistake is on the EMF side. Or I didn't see something. But anyway it won't be superfluous."*

I am not familiar with the underlying codebase, but I wanted to make sure you have visibility in case any adjustments or coordinate hooks are needed on Carry On's side.

issues.title: [Bug]In version 1.21.1, play with Carry On Extend mod when a transported player crosses a Nether portal to switch dimensions, it can cause the player who initiated the transport to get stuck in the transport state.
issues.body:
**Describe the bug**
1.21.1 neoforge 21.1.248, Carry On 2.2.6, Architectury API 13.0.11+neoforge, Carry On Extend 1.5.2. In multiplayer, when carrying another player through a Nether portal into the Nether, the following happens: the carried player automatically stops being carried and nothing happens to them. But the player who initiated the carry is still in the carrying state. That means the player who started the carry can’t pick up other items, moves slowly, can’t open their inventory, and can’t switch their hotbar. Whether the carrier or the carried player logs out and back in, it doesn’t fix the issue. The only way to get it back to normal is to delete the carry-on related mod first, enter the save to refresh the data, and then reinstall the mod. The server is running arclight 1.0.2-SNAPSHOT-166b987, and it’s also on neoforge 21.1.248. Since the carry on mod itself seems like it can't directly pick up players, I first submitted an issue to the author of the carry on extend mod. I got the response, 'That's an issue with carry on itself, not my mod. My mod is only responsible for throwing things; picking things up is carry on's own business,' so I came here to submit the issue. I'll send over the issue logs and screenshots when I get the time, so please don't close this feedback for now.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. install Carry On Extend mod
2. Join a multiplayer server that has both of these mods
3. Just pick up any player
4. Carry the player through the Nether portal in the Overworld to get to the Nether, or go through a Nether portal in the Nether to get to the Overworld.

issues.title: [Bug] closing screens in ScreenEvent.Init.Pre will crash it if the screens want to destroy their resources in their remove method

ScreenEvent.Init.Pre Fired before the screen's overridable initialization method is fired.

if the screen would like to destroy something stored in the object in their removed method, it will crash because the fields are not initialized yet

issues.title: [Bug]NullPointerException in ComparableTimSort due to null NBT keys
issues.body:
**Related Issue**
This may be related to #961 (NullPointerException in sync_carry_data). However, the crash occurs at a different location (`CarryOnCommon.potionLevel`), suggesting a broader null-handling issue within the mod.

---

**Describe the bug**
When a player right-clicks a block (or during the server tick), the server throws a `java.lang.NullPointerException` in `java.util.ComparableTimSort`. The error originates from `CarryOnCommon.potionLevel` (line 211), where `Collections.sort(list)` is called on a list of NBT keys that contains a `null` element.

This causes the server thread to hang and eventually triggers the Watchdog (60-second timeout), forcing a hard shutdown. The server becomes completely unresponsive until restart.

---

**To Reproduce**
1. Install CarryOn (2.2.4.4) on a NeoForge 1.21.1 server with other mods (e.g., Create, Mekanism, AE2, Immersive Engineering).
2. Some entity or block in the world (or a player's inventory) contains NBT data with a null key (likely introduced by another mod or data corruption).
3. A player attempts to interact with (right-click) the affected block/entity, or the server simply processes a tick.
4. The server crashes with the attached stack trace.

---

**Stack Trace (relevant part)**
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "java.lang.Comparable.compareTo(Object)" because "pivot" is null
at java.base/java.util.ComparableTimSort.binarySort(ComparableTimSort.java:262)
at java.base/java.util.ComparableTimSort.sort(ComparableTimSort.java:189)
at java.base/java.util.Arrays.sort(Arrays.java:1108)
at java.base/java.util.Arrays.sort(Arrays.java:1302)
at java.base/java.util.ArrayList.sort(ArrayList.java:1804)
at java.base/java.util.Collections.sort(Collections.java:145)
at TRANSFORMER/minecraft@1.21.1/net.minecraft.nbt.StringTagVisitor.visitCompound(StringTagVisitor.java:111)
at TRANSFORMER/minecraft@1.21.1/net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag.accept(CompoundTag.java:554)
at TRANSFORMER/minecraft@1.21.1/net.minecraft.nbt.StringTagVisitor.visit(StringTagVisitor.java:15)
at TRANSFORMER/minecraft@1.21.1/net.minecraft.nbt.Tag.getAsString(Tag.java:50)
at TRANSFORMER/minecraft@1.21.1/net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag.toString(CompoundTag.java:479)
at TRANSFORMER/carryon@2.2.4/tschipp.carryon.CarryOnCommon.potionLevel(CarryOnCommon.java:211)
at TRANSFORMER/carryon@2.2.4/tschipp.carryon.common.carry.PickupHandler.tryPickUpBlock(PickupHandler.java:154)
at TRANSFORMER/carryon@2.2.4/tschipp.carryon.events.CommonEvents.onBlockClick(CommonEvents.java:82)

**Root Cause Analysis**
- `StringTagVisitor.visitCompound` sorts the NBT keys using `Collections.sort`.
- If any key in the `CompoundTag` is `null` (which can happen if another mod writes malformed NBT), the sort operation throws an NPE because `Comparable` cannot handle `null` values.
- `CarryOnCommon.potionLevel` does not filter out `null` keys before calling `toString()` on the NBT tag, leading to the crash.

**Environment**
Minecraft: 1.21.1
Mod Loader: NeoForge 21.1.233
CarryOn Version: 2.2.4.4
Java Version: 21.0.2 (Oracle)

issues.title: [Feature Request] chest boat compatibility
issues.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Carrying a chest across water is awkward. You have to place down your chest, craft a chest boat, and manually transfer the items to the chest boat.
It's also a little annoying that, as of 1.19, chest boats can't be separated back into chests and boats.

I would love to see held chests able to be placed directly into boats. You should also be able to pick up a chest from a boat and carry it off.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
- Shift-clicking on a chest boat should pick up just the chest, rather than the whole boat.
- Attempting to place a carried chest on a boat with at least one empty seat should turn the boat into a chest boat.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
In vanilla, shift-clicking on a chest boat is how you open the inventory without getting into the boat. My proposed solution would partially overwrite this functionality, but you could still open the chest-boat inventory if you have an item in at least one hand, so i don't think this would be too disruptive.

**Additional context**
The same interactions could be added to minecarts too, allowing the player to separate chests/furnaces/hoppers from minecarts. this used to be possible by breaking the minecart, but as of 1.19 the chest minecart drops as one item.
It would be so neat to be able to pick up a chest, place it into a minecart, and send it off down some tunnel system somewhere :)

Just wanna say i really love this mod. so simple and yet so packed with emergent goofiness. My brother just figured out we can put chickens on top of villagers to make the villagers attracted to held seeds- absolute cinema. thank you for creating and maintaining this wonderful piece of technology.

issues.title: [Bug] 1.21.1 / NeoForge - Server crash when picking up chests with Carry On
issues.body:
**Describe the bug**
On Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge), the Carry On mod causes a hard server crash when a player attempts to pick up a vanilla chest.

The crash occurs synchronously inside the server tick loop, resulting in a full server shutdown (not a soft disconnect or player-only crash). Once triggered, the server must be manually restarted.

This issue has been reliably reproduced and isolated to Carry On. Removing the Carry On mod resolves the crashing behavior, and the crash can be reintroduced by re-adding the mod, followed by picking up a chest again.

...

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Start the Server
2. Install Carry On
3. Join the server
4. Place a vanilla chest
5. Attempt to pick up the chest using Carry On

...

**Game Information:**
- Minecraft Version: 1.21.1
- Mod Loader: NeoForge 21.1.209
- Carry On Version: 2.2.4.x (NeoForge build)

...

**Additional context, logs:**

*Environment:*
- Dedicated Linux server (headless)
- Java 21 (Amazon Corretto / OpenJDK)
- ~100 installed mods (large modpack)

The crash originates, as far as I can see, from Carry On’s server tick handling, specifically during logic that evaluates the carried object’s state.

...

*Observed stack trace characteristics:*

Exception in server tick loop
java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException

Triggered during CarryOnCommon.onCarryTick(...)

Failure occurs while serializing or iterating NBT data (CompoundTag.toString() / StringTagVisitor)

Crash propagates up the tick loop, terminating the entire server process

This strongly suggests an NBT handling / container data edge case when Carry On attempts to process a TileEntity-backed container (e.g., chest) under NeoForge 1.21.1.

issues.title: [Bug] Entities are invisible when having First-person Model mod installed
issues.body: As the title says, holding either a mob or a block completely makes them invisible. Making your character look like its holding onto a ghost. I used to play the game with these two mods together in 1.21.4 and there was no issue. This problem is in 1.21.10 An issue about this has been made on the first person model mod git and the developer says its the way carry on is made. https://github.com/tr7zw/FirstPersonModel/issues/160

issues.title: [Bug] Respawning / Teleporting player cause game crash / error message on Fabric 1.21.10 and 1.21.11
issues.body: **Describe the bug** In Fabric 1.21.10, LAN multiplayer of 2 players, when Teleporting a person next to me, or respawning, sometimes the game throws an error message. This happens randomly, not every teleport can cause this. I don't remember what will happen if i re-enter the save slot right after this bug occurs, but it would probably be un-enterable too because i remembered that i never chose to re-entering the save, I just close and launch the game again. issues.title: [Bug]NBT null value exception
issues.body:
**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

When picking up, carrying, or placing blocks/entities (especially complex TileEntities with NBT data storage), the Minecraft server crashes abruptly or the client game quits to desktop. The root cause is a NullPointerException (NBT null value exception) in the CarryOn MOD, which fails to handle empty or invalid NBT data of blocks/entities, leading to runtime errors.

Start the Minecraft server/client with CarryOn MOD (version v2.2.4) and other dependent mods installed (e.g., Forge/NeoForge).

Enter the game world and switch to Survival or Creative mode (the problem occurs in both modes).

Approach a complex block (TileEntity, e.g., minecraft:chest, minecraft:furnace) or an entity (e.g., chicken, cow) that is not in the CarryOn blacklist.

Use the default pickup key (or right-click, depending on CarryOn settings) to pick up the target block/entity.

Observe the game/server state: the server crashes immediately (console displays error information) or the client quits to desktop without warning; if carrying successfully, placing the block/entity may also trigger the crash.

issues.title: [Feature Request] Make commands triggered from Scripts silent
issues.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
When commands are run from scripts (from `commandPickup`, `commandLoop`, or `commandPlace`) admins and moderators can see all commands and functions being executed. This causes a flood of which renders the script feature very difficult to work with.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
It would be ideal if the commands triggered by scripts were silent. That is, they did not send their output in chat.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
The alternative is to directly listen to certain emitted **CarryOn** events, which _should_ be possible? I have seen NeoForge-related events, but they don't seem to be exposed or easy to find.

I currently, nastily work around this sometimes by silencing command output through the `sendCommandFeedback` gamerule.
```json
"effects": {
	"commandPickup" : "gamerule sendCommandFeedback false",
	"commandLoop" : "effect give @s farmersdelight:comfort 1 1 true",
	"commandPlace" : "gamerule sendCommandFeedback true"
}
```
Within the limits of external scripting, I may also periodically check `player.carryOnData` for its contents and apply conditions accordingly (_although the existing code would not work for the most recent version of CarryOn, `2.2.4`_)


**Additional context**
I must note that a lot of code in [my modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/bubble-cobble-redux) is handled through [KubeJS](https://kubejs.com/), but scripts can be an exception.

issues.title: Critical SynchedEntityData Index Collision Caused by Carry On — Breaks Multiplayer Compatibility with Animations, Combat, and Player State Mods
issues.body:
The mod Carry On introduces SynchedEntityData fields on the player entity using fixed indices, without checking whether those indices are already occupied by other mods.

This causes silent data corruption in multiplayer environments, especially in large modpacks (250–300+ mods).
When another mod also uses SynchedEntityData (e.g. PlayerAnimator, SeriousPlayerAnimations, Better Combat, and others), Carry On’s fields overwrite existing indices, leading to type mismatches between server and client.

The result is:

* Immediate disconnection from servers

* “Invalid entity data item type for field XX” errors

* Client crashes

* Mods falsely blamed for bugs they didn’t cause

* Servers refusing to start if dependent mods fail to load

This issue is widely reported across different mod repos, with mod authors repeatedly stating:

“It’s CarryOn. Remove it.”

This confirms the issue is systemic and reproducible.

====================================================
Invalid entity data item type for field 24
Expected: String
Received: CompoundTag {keyPressed:0b, selected:0, tick:0, type:"INVALID"}
====================================================

issues.title: Carry on whitelisting tags doesn't work
Feature Request: Improve Flexibility for Hostile Mob Carry-On Configuration via Datapacks
issues.body:
I’ve encountered a limitation when trying to configure carrying for hostile mobs using scripts. Currently, the mod uses a default blacklist approach and also checks the MobCategory to determine whether an entity is a "monster". Additionally, the pickupHostileMobs configuration option further restricts pickup behavior for hostile mobs.

When pickupHostileMobs is set to false in the config, it becomes impossible to allow carrying specific hostile mobs in survival mode—even if they are explicitly allowed via a datapack script. This forces users to either:

Enable pickupHostileMobs globally (which may be undesirable for balance or gameplay reasons), and Manually add a large number of entity IDs to a whitelist/blacklist, which becomes impractical—especially in modpacks with many mobs.

It would be greatly appreciated if one or more of the following could be implemented:
Allow datapack scripts to override the pickupHostileMobs config setting for specific entities.
Provide an option to switch from a blacklist to a whitelist system for hostile mobs via scripts.
Make the MobCategory check optional or configurable in the script context, so that custom rules for hostile mobs can be applied independently.
This would give pack developers and server admins much finer control over which mobs can be carried, without needing to list every single entity ID.

When using **Carry On** together with the **Sounds** mod, carrying an entity or block causes Carry On to repeatedly lock or reset the selected hotbar slot. This constant “slot switching” triggers the Sounds mod’s hotbar scroll sound effect over and over, resulting in rapid sound spam.  

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Install Carry On and Sounds (tested on [Minecraft 1.21.8 + Fabric 0.17.2]).  
2. Pick up a block or entity with Carry On.  
3. While holding it, note that the selected hotbar slot is locked/reset.  
4. Sounds mod repeatedly plays the slot-switch sound in rapid succession.  

## Expected Behavior
Hotbar slot should remain stable without constantly re-triggering scroll sounds, or the Sounds mod should ignore slot resets caused by Carry On.  

## Actual Behavior
Slot-switch sound effect is spammed continuously until the carried entity is released.  

---

### Note to developers
I’m not sure whether this should be addressed on Carry On’s side (by reducing or changing how often the hotbar slot is forced) or on the Sounds mod’s side (by ignoring slot resets triggered by other mods). If there’s a recommended workaround or compatibility patch, I’d be happy to try it. Thank you for your work on these mods!

issues.title: Bug Report: NullPointerException when rendering friendsandfoes:player_illusion (CarryOn compatibility issue)
issues.body:
Mod causing the crash: Carry On
Mod affected by the crash: Friends&Foes
Game version: Minecraft 1.21.4
Mod loader: Fabric
Carry On version: 2.3.0
Friends&Foes version: 4.0.5


Crash Summary:
Game crashes when rendering the friendsandfoes:player_illusion entity.

The crash is caused by Carry On attempting to check CarryOnData.isCarrying() on an entity that doesn't have CarryOnData attached (i.e., it's null).
It's triggered when using illusion totem from this mod, game tries to spawn player illusions

Crash log excerpt:

java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "tschipp.carryon.common.carry.CarryOnData.isCarrying()" because "carry" is null 
at net.minecraft.class_572.handler$bab000$carryon$onSetupAnimations(class_572.java:554)

This happens when spawning or encountering the entity:

friendsandfoes:player_illusion

 Steps to Reproduce:
Install Carry On and Friends&Foes together in Fabric (MC 1.21.4)

Spawn the entity with:

/summon friendsandfoes:player_illusion
Game crashes instantly when it tries to render the entity.

 Expected Behavior:
Carry On should safely check for null before accessing carry data on entities.

 Technical Diagnosis:
This line causes the issue:

carry.isCarrying() // ← carry is null for PlayerIllusionEntity
I think it should be:

if (carry != null && carry.isCarrying()) { ... }
 Suggested Fix:
Add a null check before accessing CarryOnData.



Blacklisting the entity via config does not help, because crash happens during rendering, not interaction.

🙏 Final Note:
It would be very helpful to add a null check in the rendering hook to avoid crashing with entities that don’t use CarryOnData.

Thanks for your work — love the mod! 🔥

issues.title: I accidentally chunkbanned myself on a singleplayer world with this mod.
issues.body:
Hi, so I had this issue last night, I've since fixed my world so that it loads again but I did end up losing all my animals so that sucked. Anyways, the mods related in this issue are this one (CarryOn) and DragN's Livestock Overhaul mod. What I did is that I was moving my livestock around with the CarryOn mod because they were all clumped in a corner for some reason. I picked up a sheep and accidentally placed it on the same block that one of my donkeys was on, my game then froze and crashed. Trying to reload the world would just crash the game. I fixed this by disabling and re-enabling DragN's Livestock mod and mods dependent on it, which wiped all of my pets and livestock from the world, but did make it loadable. 

This could have been much worse but I am disappointed in losing my pets. I recommend adding some sort of safeguard against this happening, maybe not allowing a player to place a mob on an occupied block, or do something similar to spawn eggs where when a new mob is place the first one gets pushed to an adjacent block? I have no experience making Minecraft mods so I don't know if those are actually possible I'm just spitballing ideas.

I am using CurseForge modloader, forge version 47.4.0, on Minecraft version 1.20.1. Mod version was the latest for 1.20.1 (1.20.1 - 2.1.2.7) Crash report and log file attached.

issues.title: Incompatibility with "Hold My Items": Carried Entity Not Visible in First-Person
issues.body:
When both _Carry On_ and _Hold My Items_ mods are installed, the carried entity is not visible in first-person view. This makes it difficult to interact with or confirm that an entity is being carried. The issue does not occur when only _Carry On_ is installed.

**Steps to Reproduce:**

1.     Install Carry On and Hold My Items together.
2.     Pick up an entity using Carry On in first-person view.
3.     Observe that the carried entity is not visible.

**Expected Behavior:**

- The carried entity should be visible in first-person, as it normally is when only Carry On is installed.

**Versions:**

-     Carry On: 2.2.2
-     Hold My Items: 4.0
-     Minecraft Version: 1.21.1
-     Fabric Version: 0.16.10

Additional Notes:
This issue may be caused by a rendering conflict between the two mods. Disabling Hold My Items restores proper functionality in first-person view.

issues.title: [Compatibility] Strange error on dedicated servers
issues.body:
When sneaking on a dedicated server in certain circumstances, the player gets disconnected, and can not reconnect. 

The error in the client logs is: 
```log
[14Feb2025 21:46:10.483] [Render thread/ERROR] [net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientCommonPacketListenerImpl/]: Failed to handle packet ClientboundSetEntityDataPacket[id=490, packedItems=[DataValue[id=0, serializer=net.minecraft.network.syncher.EntityDataSerializer$$Lambda/0x0000000800e6b8e0@7a0f4067, value=2], DataValue[id=23, serializer=net.minecraft.network.syncher.EntityDataSerializers$3@69d394cc, value={keyPressed:1b,selected:0,tick:546,type:"INVALID"}]]]

java.lang.IllegalStateException: Invalid entity data item type for field 23 on entity LocalPlayer['Suppressed'/490, l='ClientLevel', x=-1885.81, y=230.00, z=-791.11]: old=(class java.lang.String), new={keyPressed:1b,selected:0,tick:546,type:"INVALID"}(class net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag)
```

It also outputs a network protocol error in the client debug folder with related info: 
https://mclo.gs/1VaoXzD

___ 

What's especially odd here is that the issue is reproduced consistently in the right circumstances (every attempt to press the key results in a disconnect), but that those circumstances are *incredibly* unclear. 

- This began happening recently in a v13 test build of our modpack <https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/medieval-mc-mmc5>, but the issue did not occur on versions v12 or earlier
- Carry On did not change versions between v12 and v13
- The issue occurs on both Neoforge 21.1.115 (v12) and 21.1.119 (v13)
- The issue does not seem to be due to any added mods between v12 and v13
- Removing the following mods prevents the crash, but adding a few of *any* of them reintroduces the crash: 
```
not_enough_glyphs
discerning_the_eldritch
undergardendelight
too_many_bows
aether_protect_your_moa
chimericlib
athenaeum
arsdelight
ars_nouveau
hackersandsladhers
rpg_companions_tiny_dragons
ars_additions
gtbcs_spell_lib
gametechbcs_spellbooks
alshanex_familiars
supplementaries
amendments
```
- Strangest of all, adding these mods in a standalone instance with Carry On *does not* cause the crash. 

___

I realize this probably isn't very actionable, but leaving it here as a working issue in case others encounter it and have more useful information.

issues.title: Settings spontaneously revert to the default when using the config screen.
issues.body:
Continuation of my comment in #733.

Making any change in the config screen can cause some settings to be reverted to their default values. I've observed this on tile-blacklist, entity-blacklist, and tile-whitelist. Presumably, all list-type settings are affected.

There are three phenomenons at play here:
- After changing any setting on the screen, **all** settings are written to the config file.
- Upon opening the config screen, it always shows the default values for list-type settings, instead of showing the active settings.
- Changes to list-type settings don't take effect until the game is restarted.

### Repro:
1. Before starting the game. Open the config file in a text editor, and remove `minecraft:armor_stand` from the entity blacklist.
2. Start the game, and confirm that you are able to pick-up armor stands.
    - (Optional) In the config screen, observe that armor stands are listed in the entity blacklist
3. In the config screen, change an unrelated settings, e.g, increase `maxDistance`.
   - (Optional) After closing the config screen, reopen the config file: Observe that armor stands are again listed in the entity blacklist.
4. Restart the game: You are no longer able to pick-up armor stands.


### Versions:
Minecraft 1.21.4
Carry-On 2.3.0
Cloth Config 17.0.144
Fabric Loader 0.16.10
Fabric API 0.115.1

issues.title: Incorrect vertical orientation when placing stairs on the side of a block.
issues.body:
In vanilla, when placing stairs against the side of a block, the vertical orientation of the stairs depend on which half of the block you are aiming at: aiming at the upper-half will place it upside down, aiming at the lower-half will place it upright.

With carry-on, the vertical orientation instead depends on where the player's feet are located relative to the target block: standing above will place the stairs upside-down, standing at the same level or below will place the stairs upright.

issues.title: Certain mobs disappear when placed down after teleporting when carrying them (on a server)
issues.body:
Fabric 1.20.1, mod version carryon-fabric-1.20.1-2.1.2.7

Initially encountered picking up goblin traders in the nether - teleporting back to my overworld base (using /home) and then placing them down they would just disappear (as in, they were in my arms just fine but vanished when I placed them). I thought this was just a problem with the goblin trader mod, but then today I picked up a trader llama in the overworld and teleported home, and that vanished too.

No other mobs seem to disappear - I've spent an hour flying around the overworld to try and find a normal llama to test that but no luck.

I've gone into a single player world to test it there and neither goblin traders nor trader llamas disappear when placing them after teleporting.

### Expected Behavior
After clicking the expand buttons, more items will show.

### Actual Behavior
After clicking the expand buttons, nothing changes.

issues.title: I get sent to "Purgatory" when Holding a friend that logs out.
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior
I drop my friend and they relog.

### Actual Behavior
This is a glitch I'm calling the Purgatory Glitch. This only happens in multiplayer. When you are carrying another player, and that player disconnects, you are sent to “purgatory”. This makes you unable to scroll through your hotbar, open your inventory, or move faster than the slow walk while appear empty. You cannot see any other players, and they cannot see you. No entities render or can affect you, including hostile mobs. You cannot take damage, neither fall damage, suffocation damage, or player damage. Your hunger does go down, however, you do not take hunger damage. Your bubbles also go down, but you do not take drowning damage.
 I am playing on a server with Origins Mod, and so as an Enderian, I do not take water damage, and my phantom friends do not take sun damage. When you use an ability, it does not show for you, but your fellow players can see it affect the world.
The block states seem to pause, and you cannot see any item drops or pick up items. If someone places blocks, the one in “purgatory” simply rebounds out of open air. You can only break instant break blocks, and it breaks and drops for your friends although it simply disappears for you. Two part blocks glitch, such as doors or beds. You can trample crops, although it looks normal to you. You cannot hit other players, but you CAN text in the chat.
I have a minimap, and all things except myself disappear from it. No mobs or players show up. My friend also discovered that the world stops loading in when you are in purgatory. You can walk a certain distance away but the world does not load any farther.
This only happens if a player being held disconnects, if the person holding them disconnects they are simply dropped. 
If there are more than two players on the server, then the player sent to “purgatory” cannot see ANYONE, and no one can see said trapped player. 
This glitch is easy to get out of, a simple relog fixes the player trapped in purgatory, but I was wondering what could have caused this, and if this was a me whoopsie when making the pack, or just something that might happen when playing multiplayer with carryon.


### Steps to Reproduce
Be on multiplayer
Pick up another player
have that player disconnect
You are now in "purgatory"

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge/Fabric
1.20.1, 1.20.1-2.1.2.7, Fabric

issues.title: Issue with Moving and Opening Loot Chests in Minecraft 1.21 with Lootr and Carry On Mods
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior
In previous versions (Minecraft 1.20.1), we could use the "Lootr" mod along with "Carry On" to pick up loot chests from structures and bring them back to our base. There, other players who didn’t join the expedition could open these chests and get the loot.

### Actual Behavior
In the current version (Minecraft 1.21, Fabric 0.16.0), when attempting to replicate this behavior, two issues occurred:
1. My teammate could not pick up any mobs, chests, chests with minecarts, etc., using the "Carry On" mod. This issue was resolved after a while by changing some key binds, but I’m not sure if that’s the reason it was fixed. I suggest improving the user’s ability to select buttons for picking up items in the game.

2. After bringing loot chests back to base, my teammate tried to open them, but they would instantly close. When I tried opening them myself, the same issue occurred. This problem only affects loot chests naturally generated in structures, while minecart chests in mineshafts can still be opened without issue.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. In Minecraft 1.21, Fabric 0.16.0, load the "Lootr" and "Carry On" mods.
2. Use "Carry On" to try picking up and moving loot chests from naturally generated structures.
3. Attempt to open these chests in a new location after moving them.

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge/Fabric
- Minecraft: 1.21
- Fabric: 0.16.0
- Lootr: lootr-fabric-1.21.1-10.1.3
- Carry On: carryon-fabric-1.21-2.2.1

issues.body:
**Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1
**Forge Version:** 52.0.24
**Java Version:** 21.0.5 

**Issue:** Game crashes with ClassCastException in CarryOnDataManager.getCarryData when loading a save. The error appears to be related to casting ServerPlayer objects.

**Error Message:**

`

**Mod List:**

issues.title: Inability to Perform Any Actions After Carrying Paintings - Carry On Mod
issues.body:
Description:
While using the Carry On Mod, I attempted to pick up a painting by holding Shift and right-clicking on it. The painting disappeared from the wall but did not appear in my hands or inventory. More critically, during the time the painting is being carried, the player is unable to perform any other actions, such as opening crafting tables or attacking zombies, until the painting is placed back. This significantly restricts gameplay while the painting is being carried.

Steps to Reproduce:

Install Carry On Mod.
Place a painting on any wall in the game.
Shift + Right-Click (with empty hands) on the painting to pick it up.
Observe that the painting does not appear in the player’s hands or inventory.
Attempt to perform other actions (such as opening a crafting table, attacking mobs, etc.).
Note that all actions are blocked until the painting is placed back.

Expected Result:
The painting should appear in the player's hands, and the player should be able to freely perform other actions, such as opening crafting tables or attacking hostile mobs, even while carrying the painting.

Actual Result:
The painting disappears, and the player is unable to perform any other actions while carrying the painting, only resuming normal activities once the painting is placed back.

Mod Version: [2.1.2.7]

Minecraft Version: [1.20.1]

![2024-08-23_17 50 20](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/81e49bd7-164c-4b9c-8214-f407d3cf4fb2)

issues.title: Unable to Re-place Paintings After Carrying Them with Carry On Mod
issues.body:
Description:
While using the Carry On Mod, I attempted to pick up a painting by shifting and right-clicking on it. The painting was removed from the wall, but it did not appear in my hands or inventory. Additionally, I was unable to place the painting back on the wall or any other surface. This issue makes it impossible to carry or reposition paintings after they have been picked up.

Steps to Reproduce:

Install Carry On Mod.
Place a painting on any wall in the game.
Shift + Right-Click (with empty hands) on the painting to pick it up.
Notice that the painting is no longer visible in your hands or inventory.
Attempt to place the painting back on any surface.

Expected Result:
The painting should appear in the player's hands and should be able to be placed back on a wall or other surfaces.

Actual Result:
The painting disappears and cannot be placed back, leaving the player unable to reposition it.

Mod Version: [2.1.2.7]

Minecraft Version: [1.20.1]

issues.title: Picking up Mo' Creatures: Extended entities causes game crash
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior

Shift+Right clicking a Mo' Creatures: Extended mob should pick it up.

### Actual Behavior

Shift+Right clicking a Mo' Creatures: Extended mob crashes the game with the error "Failed to load entity NBT" and the server cannot be rejoined again by that player until Carry On is removed from the mod list of both server and client.

### Steps to Reproduce

  1. Install Carry On and Mo' Creatures Extended
  2. Shift+Right click on a Mo' Creatures Extended mob

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge/Fabric

Minecraft: 1.12.2
Carry On: 1.12.7.23
Forge: 14.23.5.2860

I hate to drum up an old issue, especially on an obsolete MC version, but the same issue occurs with the remake Mo'Creatures: Extended for 1.12.2 that was occurring with the original mod and was fixed here...

[Picking up Mo' Creatures entities causes game crash #229
](https://github.com/Tschipp/CarryOn/issues/229) 

I know getting an update would be a lot to ask but if you are still working on older versions this would be great.

issues.title: Sophisticated Storage Compatibility issue
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior

When holding chests, the contents inside should not fall out.
When repositioned on the floor they should be usable
And should be able to be placed next to another chest to make a double chest.

### Actual Behavior

When holding the chests all their contents fall out
When put back on the floor they are not usable (at least not at the first try)
And cannot be placed next to another chest to make a double chest.

### Steps to Reproduce

https://imgur.com/ktrfk8G

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge/Fabric

Minecraft 1.20.1
Forge 1.20.1 - 47.3.5

sophisticatedcore-1.20.1-0.6.22.611
sophisticatedstorage-1.20.1-0.10.25.804
carryon-forge-1.20.1-2.1.2.7

(All mods are in their latest version)

issues.title: Interaction entities are not forbidden, breaking data packs
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior
Interaction entities should not be movable by players, as they are technical entities used by data packs to detect interactions in certain volumes. In fact, Carry On overriding their crouch + right-click behavior voids any crouch + right-click behavior implemented by the data pack that manages the interaction entity.

### Actual Behavior
Interaction entities can be carried by players by default, causing data packs using them to break.

### Steps to Reproduce

issues.title: Mobs can be placed inside walls
issues.body:
### Actual Behavior

Mobs can be placed inside certain solid blocks. For shorter mobs (chickens, pigs, cats, etc), this results in death by suffocation.

This can be done with any solid block shorter than a full block. This includes dirt paths and farmland blocks. I do not know of any other vanilla blocks this can occur with.

This does not occur with soulsand, as they  occupy a full block despite their hitbox being shorter.

### Expected Behavior

Mobs probably should not be able to be placed within these blocks. Or keep it, it's kinda funny. Though I did discover this bug by accidentally killing a cat

### Steps to Reproduce

- Place a path block or farmland block adjacent to a solid, full-sized block
- Pick up a mob
- Aim crosshair at the sliver of the solid block poking out above the path block
- Place mob

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge/Fabric

I have recorded a video of me suffocating a pig with a path block. This video was recorded on Minecraft 1.20.1, Forge 47.2.0, Carry On 2.1.2.7, along with some other mods I was playing with at the time.
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kKbeRYZ2zPI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kKbeRYZ2zPI)

After the fact, I tested with Minecraft 1.20.4, Forge 49.0.50, Carry On 2.1.3 without any other mods installed. The issue still occurs in this scenario as well.

## Description

- Add "create_new_age:*" to "forbiddenTiles" in CarryConfig.java

issues.body:
(This was mentioned on the Supplementaries repo, but they said it was most likely a problem with Carryon, so I'm bringing it up here.)

### Expected Behavior
Placing the urn should either shouldn't remain in hand when placed, or should have an error saying that it cannot be placed midair.

### Actual Behavior
The Urn remains in-hand and places to fall, dropping whatever loot comes from them infinitely, until the urn is placed directly on the ground.

### Steps to Reproduce
-Run a modpack that combines Carry on, and Supplementaries
-Open a world (This bug was found in survival, but most likely works in creative too.)
-Go underground and locate any Supplementary Urn

issues.title: NullPointerException on player replacing a block with a carried TiledEntity
issues.body: Hi, I've just installed the mod but I've noticed an odd crash happening each time the player _replaces_ a block with a tiled entity having a GUI screen. Here's a quick summary of the issue. Hope I can help! :) ### Expected Behavior - When a furnace block is placed and player opens up the GUI (opening it very quickly after the block is placed), a properly aligned menu should show up and a NullPointerException shouldn't be triggered. ### Actual Behavior - When the player holds a furnace block (And they place it on top of a tall grass block, or any other replaceable tile) the GUI opens up exactly at the same time as the tile entity is placed. This presumably causes the game to refer to a non-present pointer of the Recipe Book causing a NullPointerException and an immediant crash. ### Steps to Reproduce 1. The player needs to pick up **any tile entity with a recipe book** (ex. blast furnace, smoker, furnace) 2. Afterwards place it on top of any replaceable block - for example tall grass or a flower. 3. When done, the game should freeze and crash. This will not work for _crafting tables_, but it seems to cause chests to play an opening animation for a short period of time. - I recommend to check for a condition when a block is _replaced_, this seems to cause the issue. Almost as if the player placing down a carried block caused them to open up a tiled entity's container. ### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge/Fabric - MC 1.19.2 - FORGE 43.3.0 - MOD 1.19.2-2.1.1.22 ### Screenshots encouraged Screenshots displaying this: "oddly aligned GUI for furnace and blast furnace". issues.body:
Found a, mostly useless, duplication glitch for lava that can be placed inside of the Mekanism heat generator. Useless by itself but can become annoying for players trying to remove their heat generator only to place it down and have lava also place with it. issues.title: [Feature Request] Ability to unlock hotbar selection
issues.body:
It would be great to have a way to give the player normal use of their inventory even if the held item hasn't been put back down.

**Context**
There is a mod Minestuck which allows selected items to be stored in a secondary storage system on a keybind press. Since CarryOn stores the held object as an item they synergize well for the most part.

**Issue with context**
However CarryOn still believes the carried item is in selected slot. Until another object is picked up and put back down, the player cannot change which hotbar slot is selected which can be a frustration. This has been the case since at least 1.14

**Ideas**
Could come in the form of a config that checks whether the held item is no longer in the selected and frees up the hotbar or perhaps a command which could be accessible via advancement datapack. I imagine this could have use for additional mods!

issues.title: Carryon should disable picking of autopath blocks by default

Basically, it accidentally picked up one of the @lebonq's [Autopath](https://github.com/lebonq/Automatic-Path) (mod that add grass block degradation depending of the amount of entities walking over it) blocks.

Honestly, i don't know exactly how to blacklist certain blocks of other mods (or the entire rooster of blocks of a specific mod id), but i think it would be a good thing regardless to the mod by default deny picking those blocks, since the BE they have is just for internal purposes (track the amount of wear) and not something meant to directly interact with the player (like inventories).

issues.title: [Fabric] Stop embedding `amecsapi`
issues.body:
This mod doesn't really depends on `amecsapi`. It can be removed safely.
It's causing some conflict issues because of Mixins in `amecsapi`. (e.g. https://github.com/Nova-Committee/ModernKeyBinding/issues/7)
Also [this line](https://github.com/Tschipp/CarryOn/blob/5efb509aeaea18860af4b78219daa9da19c16d65/Common/src/main/java/tschipp/carryon/client/keybinds/CarryOnKeybinds.java#L17 "Tschipp/CarryOn") is pointless since `amecsapi` is embedded.

### Fix
Change `modImplementation` to `modRuntimeOnly`, and remove `include`.

`Fabric/build.gradle`
```diff
dependencies {
    ...

+    modRuntimeOnly "de.siphalor:amecsapi-1.20:1.5.0+mc1.20-pre1"
-    modImplementation "de.siphalor:amecsapi-1.20:1.5.0+mc1.20-pre1"
-    include "de.siphalor:amecsapi-1.20:1.5.0+mc1.20-pre1"
}
```

issues.title: Carry On Fires Forge's attack entity event wrongly, breaking other mods by falsely claiming entities are being attacked
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior

Carry On to not lie to mods telling them an entity is attacked when it is not

### Actual Behavior

Carry On's fires an event [that extends Forge's AttackEntityEvent](https://github.com/Tschipp/CarryOn/blob/1.18/src/main/java/tschipp/carryon/common/handler/PickupHandler.java#L167). This means it will be caught by all listeners of `AttackEntityEvent`, which per the forge doc is fired when a player attacks an entity. Since your event is *not* an entity attack, it **should not** extend that forge event.

This notably causes problems with Tinkers Construct, as we use that event to handle boosting unarmed attack damage.

### Steps to Reproduce

Install any mod that uses that forge event and responds on empty hands and attempt to pick up a mob.

For instance, if you install tinkers and wear a tinkers chestplate, it will cause the mob to be punched.

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge

* Minecraft 1.18.2
* Forge is 40.1.86
* Carry On is 1.17.0.8
* You can use Tinkers Construct  3.6.0.73 to reproduce this issue if you wish, though I expect other mods are affected

### Screenshots encouraged
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12155288/212527815-9601a6b2-ac7f-4853-88f6-7fa6810eb137.png)

issues.body:
### Expected Behavior
No Crash

### Actual Behavior
Client Crash https://mcpaste.io/ec72a31b1335b247
(Server stays up fine, it's a rendering issue 100%)

issues.title: Carry On / Locks compatibility issue
issues.body:
Hello hello 👋 
My team and I are having an issue in our modpack, we'd like to add Carry On in it but it is not compatible with Locks for now (It IS but you can remove the lock on chests by picking it up, so that's kind of OP).
Just to be clear : Locks is a mod that adds locks to the game
[Locks page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/locks)

### Expected Behavior

Locked chests shouldn't be able to be picked up to prevent cheese. If a chest has a lock on it, you shouldn't be able to pick it up.

### Actual Behavior

Locked chests can be picked up with Carry On, this will automatically remove the lock on it and allow the player to open the chest effortlessly.

### Steps to Reproduce

- Download Carry On 1.16.5
- Download Locks 1.16.5
- Put any lock on a chest (ctrl+right click on the front of the chest)
- Try to pick it up with Carry On
- Voila ! The lock will instantly break and drop on the floor.

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge

- Minecraft 1.16.5
- Forge 36.2.23
- carryon-1.16.5-1.15.5.22
- locks-1.16.5-3.0.3

Here I even made you a gif to see how easy you can remove the lock 👍

issues.title: Picking up Integrated Dynamics logic cables crashes the server/client
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior
When you attempt to shift-right click on a logic cable, it should assume that it cannot be picked up.

### Actual Behavior
It attempts to pick up the cable block, with all parts attached. Effectively this works, but immediately upon success the server would crash. It happens when a variable card is in a cable part that is referenced elsewhere on its network, and cannot be found on its location anymore (since you picked it up). The mod just never intended for cables to be moved, other than mined or wrenched,

### Steps to Reproduce

- Place a logic cable (`integrateddynamics:cable`)
- Attach a display panel on one side
- Place a variable store on the other side
- Program a variable card to an integer using the logic programmer
- Program another variable card with the `Name` operator to turn the integer into a string
- Put the integer card into the display panel, and the other card in the variable store
- Attempt to shift-right click the display panel (or cable it is on)

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge
Minecraft: 1.16.5
Carry On: 1.15.5.15
Forge: 36.2.2
Integrated Dynamics: 1.9.2
CyclopsCore: 1.11.8
CommonCapabilities: 2.7.0

### Screenshots encouraged
![pick up logic cable](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14236702/129099374-8e84aed2-dc9b-49cc-a0a8-51e5c96013e7.png)

### Suggested fix
Add `integrateddynamics:cable` to the blacklist by default (not all blocks from that mod). Some blocks could be preferrable to pick up, but mostly just cables that could have game breaking stuff in them if moved.

issues.title: [1.12.2] NPE After Saving with Riding Entity
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior
The world loads with the player carrying the entity.

### Actual Behavior
NPE crash

### Steps to Reproduce
1) Install Carry On
2) Install Animania Base & Extra.
3) Install Name Pain.
4) Get a hamster on your shoulder.
5) Save and exit that world.
6) Load that world.

Doing these same steps without Carry On installed will not cause a crash.

While removing Name Pain dodges the crash, it's because it listens to RenderLivingEvent.Specials.Pre where entities should not be null, but they are when saved and loaded while riding players with Carry On. Related issues can be found [here](https://github.com/capnkirok/animaniamod/issues/468) and [here](https://github.com/Rebirth-of-the-Night/Rebirth-Of-The-Night/issues/521).

As the author of Name Pain, I will start catching null entities to avoid this, but I figured it should be patched here too.

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge
MC v1.12.2
Forge v14.24.5.2854
Carry On v1.12.3.15
Animania ~~Base v2.0.3.28~~ v1.7.3
~~Animania Extra v1.0.2.28~~
Name Pain ~~v1.3.1~~ v1.2.1

issues.title: Server config still generated in /config in 1.15.2
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior
As far as I could tell from issue #235, `carryon-server.toml` shouldn't be generated in /config/ on launch. 

### Actual Behavior
Upon launching a new game, `carryon-server.toml` is generated in `/config/`. Nothing appears in `/defaultconfigs/`, and on loading a world without a `carryon-server.toml` in `/saves/<worldname>/serverconfigs/` one is made. If the `/config/` config is changed, the `/serverconfigs/` one is not updated, even if the `/serverconfigs/` is deleted. 

Pasting the `/serverconfig/` into `/defaultconfigs/` causes any new `/serverconfigs/` generated to match `/defaultconfigs/`. Old `/serverconfigs/` are not updated.

It appears that CarryOn now uses the `/defaultconfigs/` system normally, except it also generates a useless /config/ config.

### Steps to Reproduce
Open a new instance with CarryOn and Forge, then modify `/config/` and `/defaultconfigs/`, checking `/serverconfigs/` for changes.

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge
MC 1.15.2
Forge 31.2.49
CarryOn file carryon-1.15.2-1.13.0.5

### Screenshots encouraged

If anyone has any ideas on this, please let me know.

issues.title: How to distinguish pick up events from break events?
CC: Tweaked turtles cannot be carried
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior
One may pick up and place down a turtle as normal.

### Actual Behavior
Turtles from ComputerCraft/CC:Tweaked can be picked up correctly. However, when placed at a different position, the tile thinks has a cached block state of air, which causes crashes and/or rendering issues.

The problem here is that turtles read the block state when NBT is read (yes, they shouldn't, but that's a whole 'nother issue). However, as `deserializeNBT` is called with an incorrect position, the block state will be wrong. Moreover, as `TileEnity`'s block states are cached, even after `setPos` is called, `TileEntity.getBlockState()` will continue to be incorrect.

### Steps to Reproduce
 - Pick up a turtle
 - Place it down somewhere else

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge
 - Forge 1.15.2-31.2.47
 - Carry On 1.15.2-1.13.2
 - CC: Tweaked 1.15.2-1.95.0

This should still happen on 1.16.4 as the code is largely the same in both mods.

### Screenshots encouraged
A video can be found on the CC:T issue tracker - https://github.com/SquidDev-CC/CC-Tweaked/issues/643.

---

I think the cleanest solution here would be for Carry On to patch the position NBT _before_ calling `deserializeNBT`, rather than calling `setPos` afterwards.

Obviously there's some cleanup which needs to be done on CC:T's end, but I think these changes are worth making anyway - I'm sure there's other mods doing the same silly things.

issues.title: [1.16.3] Banner duping glitch
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior
When carrying a banner over to a new coordinate, I expected the banner to be placed down when right-clicking.

### Actual Behavior
The attempt to put down a banner in a new spot has resulted in an error message in chat asking me to clear my carryon slot and to report the bug. Instead of the banner I picked up, an invisible banner has been placed on the new spot, while my hands retain the original banner. The banner has no texture/model but it retains its outline highlight thing when hovered over. The original banner can be put down successfully if I put it back to its original coordinate. The invisible banner can be mined and thus duped if replicated over and over.

A friend could replicate the below steps, however when asked if he could see the invisible banners I put down, he said no. When he was the one replicating the steps, I could not see his invisible banners, but he could mine them like I could. It seems that the banners are visible only to the player using Carry On on the banner, though once mined, the banner becomes legitimate on future interactions.

When my friend rejoined the server, he was suddenly able to see the outline of the invisible banners, however they were also absent texture/model-wise for him. He could mine them as normal.

Also, there's no actual link in the error message despite it saying "here".

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Make a banner and put it down (we had an ominous banner so we used that, but I'm not sure if this is relevant)
2. Pick the banner up using the Carry On button.
3. Place it on a different coordinate.
4. You'd receive the error message here and fail to put down the banner, but an invisible banner will be placed on the attempted coordinate. You can repeat this on many new coordinates in one go, to create multiple invisible banners.
5. Place the banner back to its original location.
6. Mine the invisible banner.
7. You now have an extra banner, which looks nothing like the original banner. When attempting to pick up the invisible banner, the same behavior happens from start to finish.

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge

Carry On version: 1.15.1.7

issues.title: Issue placing OpenBlocks grave
issues.body:
Typically upon dying, the person who died takes a a buddy for protection as they retrieve their grave to reclaim their lost inventory, carrying back to a safe location to open it: the error comes when placing it down again.

### Expected Behavior
The grave be placed down in the same orientation relative to the player's facing, relative to when they picked it up.

### Actual Behavior
The grave is placed down with the front always faced North, and the epitaph bearing the player's name is usually gone as well. It is accompanied by an error in the console reading: 
"Error detected. Cannot place block. Execute "/carryon clear" to remove the item
Please report this error here" (linking to https://github.com/Tschipp/CarryOn/issues);
Still places grave as mentioned above.

### Steps to Reproduce
Pick up a grave that spawns from a player's death, containing their inventory from when they died, then place it down again.

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge

issues.title: [1.14.4] Blacklisting Create tile entities not working
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior
Adding "create:*" to the carryon-server.toml blacklists should prevent the player from being able to pick up any entities from the Create mod.

### Actual Behavior
Create's tile entities can still be picked up, which makes using any behavior requiring sneak+right click impossible to execute.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Add "create:*" to the forbiddenTiles blacklist in the carryon-server.toml config file.
2. Add "create:*" to the forbiddenEntities blacklist in the carryon-server.toml config file.
3. Launch the game.
4. Put down any tile entity block from Create... as an example, the Encased Shaft.
5. Sneak+Right Click on the block. The player starts carrying the block. 

I've also tried this explicitly specifying the name of blocks in the blacklist, with no change in behavior.

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge
Minecraft: 1.14.4
Forge: 28.2.3
Carry On: v1.12.4
Create: v0.2.2b

issues.title: Feature Request: Option to Disallow Only Untamed Hostile Mobs for Mob Carrying
issues.body:
Pretty much what the title says.

Could display it in the menu as having the button for allowing carrying of hostile mobs cycle between `[None|Tamed_Only|Any]` rather than just `[false|true]`, and for "Tamed Only" use a combination such as  `B:pickupHostileMobs=false` and `B:tamedHostileMobExemption=true` possibly. (I know that `B:tamedHostileMobExemption` isn't *currently* a thing, but it gets the idea across.)

Turns out that some mods (which I will leave unnamed) *don't set their added (hostile-but tameable) mobs as non-hostile when tamed*, and even if the devs knew how to fix it (apparently they don't?), they would refuse to backport the fix (as they already have with the fix for another more serious bug).

I did try to figure out if similar functionality was possible to do with CarryOn scripting (basically, `OwnerUUID` *is* `""` for untamed mods and *is not* `""` for tamed ones from what I've read), though that approach seems like it would let people walk off with other people's tamed pets still (assuming that it's even *possible* to do this with a script in the first place, of course).

issues.title: Moving rustic cabinets not working as expected
issues.body:
Cross-posted from https://github.com/Darkosto/SkyFactory4Issues/issues/657
Also reported on rustic github: https://github.com/the-realest-stu/Rustic/issues/254

---

Moving rustic cabinets is very strange and doesn't always work as expected

- **Moving the top half of the cabinet to another location**
  - _The top half retains its `top: true` attribute and turns into an invisible block (unexpected)_
  - The bottom half loses its `bottom: true` attribute
- **Moving the invisible top half of the cabinet back to its original location**
  - The bottom half gains its `bottom: true` attribute back and the cabinet becomes a multiblock again
- **Moving the bottom half of the cabinet to another location**
  - The bottom half loses its `bottom: true` attribute
  - The top half loses its `top: true` attribute
- **Moving the bottom half of the cabinet back to its original location**
  - _The attributes are not changed and the two halves are not merged (unexpected)_
- **Moving the top half of the cabinet to the same location but rotated**
  - _The cabinet becomes a multiblock, but it can be opened only from the direction that each half is facing (unexpected)_

Here is a video showcasing all of these issues: https://youtu.be/AeH9_nI4oAA

---

Would giving the moved block and the surrounding blocks a block update on pickup/place fix this?

issues.title: Animals behaving as if damaged when picked up if TAN is installed
issues.body:
### Expected Behavior
Pick up animals peacefully

### Actual Behavior
The animals, if Tough as Nails is installed, behave as if they are being damaged. They are not effectively taking any damage but act like so, turning red and emitting noise as if being damaged.
This can become annoying with other mods installed, like Better with Mods (the other animals start fleeing in group as a response of the picked up animal "damage"). And with Animania installed animals can become dangerous too, because they start to defend themselves as if being provoked (even a crowded henhouse could become deadly).

Nothing that can't be worked around by turning off the BWM group flee feature, but I thought it was worth of mentioning.
I'm 110% sure that is TAN which is causing the problem. Tried a clean istance with only just CarryOn and one with only CarryOn and TAN to be sure (not even utility mods like JEI; tried with TAN versions 3.1.0.132 and .135).

### Steps to Reproduce
Install Tough as Nails.

### Version of Minecraft, Carry On, Forge
1.12.2, 1.12, 2768

issues.title: Blacklist Malisisdoors
issues.body:
> 
> I've found one unfortunate interaction between Carry On and Malisis Doors.  If you try for any reason to open certain Malisis Doors custom doors while sneaking¹ (this affects at least all of the 3x3 double doors), you will find yourself suddenly carrying the door.
> 
>  
> 
> If you're using Malisis Doors and Carry On together, you should probably blacklist at least the following tile entities:
> 
>  
> 
> malisisdoors:big_door_acacia_3x3
> malisisdoors:big_door_birch_3x3
> malisisdoors:big_door_dark_oak_3x3
> malisisdoors:big_door_iron_3x3
> malisisdoors:big_door_jungle_3x3
> malisisdoors:big_door_oak_3x3
> malisisdoors:big_door_rusty_3x3
> malisisdoors:big_door_spruce_3x3
> 
>  
> 
> You might need to blacklist others as well, probably the carriage and mediaeval doors, possibly some of the smaller custom doors.  If in doubt, I'm pretty sure it's safe to just blacklist malisisdoors.* altogether.
> 
> 
> 
> ____
> 
> ¹  Well, I wasn't actually trying to sneak through the door, you understand.  But a few times I've been on a steep flying descent, precision approach, landed RIGHT in front of the door, clicked to open it with shift still down, and found myself holding the door.  Oops.  Took me three or four times to realize what was happening.
> 

Reported by CaerMaster

issues.title: Please clarify licensing
issues.body:
Hello, I'd like to make sure it's clear what the licensing terms are for this mod.  On curseforge it has the LGPLv3 selected, but at the bottom of the description is a block of copyright terms that contradict the LGPL, and in the code repository I see no LICENSE file at all.

If I understand correctly, this is a bit of an awkward legal status because it's not clear that the source code itself is licensed under the LGPL, which makes it hard to consider it open source (as opposed to just a permissively licensed binary blob).

If this mod is intended to be LGPL, my advice is to remove the erroneous copyright block at the bottom of the cf description, or clarify that it applies to the official Carry On jars but not to derivative works, and also include a LICENSE.txt in the repository with the chosen license.

(If the intent is to keep anyone from re-using this code in a mod that is posted on another site, then you will want to remove the LGPL tag, but it would be sad if this ambitious mod can't be part of the growing open source mod ecosystem!)

issues.title: Modular Routers & Carry On 1st person item rendering
issues.body:
Hi, Modular Routers author here.  You might have noticed a comment on Curseforge from SilverDarkBlade regarding (1st person) rendering problems when holding carryable blocks (plain white or completely missing textures for the carried block).

I've done some research, and discovered that Modular Routers particle rendering code is definitely related to this problem, although I haven't figured out whether it's me or you at fault yet :)  Anyway, the specific line that causes the problems is https://github.com/desht/ModularRouters/blob/MC1.12-master/src/main/java/me/desht/modularrouters/client/fx/FXSparkle.java#L61 :

```Minecraft.getMinecraft().renderEngine.bindTexture(particles);```

Comment that out, and the problem disappears.

This code is called during particle drawing, which is run from a ``RenderWorldLastEvent`` event handler.

I guess the question is, why does binding a texture to do some drawing work affect your rendering of held blocks?  I haven't looked at your code, but I presume you're rendering the block from a ``RenderWorldLastEvent`` handler which runs after mine?  And somehow that bound texture is messing the rendering up?

Anyway, thought I'd put this here and see if you have a better idea about it than me...

issues.title: [1.12] Picking Up Death Animations
issues.body:
So I found an interesting discovery when messing around with the mod. Whenever an entity enters the death animation, apparently you can pick them up while they are in the middle of it. 

![2017-08-28_15 36 33](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28495960/29792892-879e44c8-8c07-11e7-82b8-36134d975644.png)

I tested this with a variety of different entities to see what results I get, but it doesn't have any effect in terms of major exploits. However, there was one major oddity that might raise _some_ level of concern.

If an entity triggers an event after the death animation (i.e. Slimes summoning their smaller counterparts), you can trigger that event every time you pick the entity up in the death state. This means you can activate the trigger as much as you want every time you pick up the entity in that state.

![2017-08-28_16 00 49](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28495960/29793640-4b379630-8c0a-11e7-92fd-9f055c69b48f.png)
(This was the effect from one Slime.)

While you can repeat the animation trigger every time you pick up the death state, the internal timer of the animation will be saved each time, so you cannot repeat the trigger indefinitely.
